title: Real-time personalized brain state-dependent TMS in healthy adults
description: This dataset contains raw EEG and transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) data from healthy adults, collected to test real-time, personalized brain state-dependent stimulation. Whole-brain activity patterns were decoded in real time to predict activation of the corticospinal tract, with motor evoked potentials as the outcome measure. The companion publication (Khatri, Pulliam, Manesiya, Cortez, Millán and Hussain, 'Personalized whole-brain activity patterns predict human corticospinal tract activation in real-time', Brain Stimulation, 2024) is in press and has no DOI yet.
methods_description: Raw EEG and TMS data were recorded from healthy adults (BrainVision format: .eeg/.vhdr/.vmrk). During stimulation, whole-brain EEG activity patterns were decoded in real time using a personalized model to predict corticospinal tract activation, indexed by motor evoked potentials elicited by TMS. Real-time and offline analyses were performed with the code available at https://github.com/SMNPLab/Realtime_decoding_neurotypical.git
